title: ChatGPT publishing pipeline test (demo)
description: Fictional session created solely to verify that ChatGPT can add summit content directly to GitHub. This is not part of the real techNL Summit agenda.

summary.overview: This is a demonstration of the content publishing pipeline, not a summary of an actual conference talk. It verifies that a new JSON file can be added remotely and rendered by the summit site after the branch is pulled.
keyTakeaways: A standalone JSON file can represent a published session.
The site should discover new session files during its Vite build.
notableIdeas: Test remote content publishing before relying on it at the conference.
practicalApplications: Pull the updated feature branch and confirm this session is listed and its detail page loads.
